messages:
Clara Moon: Kickoff for a one-page enterprise solution brief + micro-landing. Audience: procurement and platform teams at regulated companies. Must-haves: succinct value prop, three pillars (security controls, SLA guardrails, deployment modes), procurement checklist, lead-routing spec, conservative benchmark callout, CTA A/B plan. Keep it one page max.

Ethan Park: Proposed headline: 'Secure, predictable LLM inference — deploy where your policy requires.' Then three micro-sections: Data Protection, Reliability & SLAs, Deployment Options. Each 2-4 bullets.

Sanjay Rao: For the benchmark hero callout, suggest conservative copy: "Internal Redwood lab: Dedicated + KV caching + 8-bit quantization reduced unit cost ~24% at sustained embedding throughput; p99 generation latency ~100-130ms on our benchmark model. Internal results; customer workloads may vary." Include a tiny chart on the landing.

Mira Chen: Lead routing rules idea: capture fields [deployment_pref, compliance_level, expected_qps, procurement_window_days]. Simple routing pseudocode we can hand to eng:
```
if compliance_level == 'high' or deployment_pref == 'Private' or expected_qps > 2000:
  route_to('AE')
elif procurement_window_days < 30 and expected_qps > 500:
  route_to('SolutionsEng')
else:
  route_to('SelfServe')
```
Also add CRM tags: enterprise-signal, security-review.

LegalBot: Language check: use qualifiers. Recommend phrasing: "supports customer-managed KMS, VPC/private control plane options, audit logs, and configurable data retention." For SLA: "SLA-backed uptime subject to standard exclusions (scheduled maintenance, force majeure)." Do not assert certifications without documentation.

Clara Moon: Procurement checklist (short): 1) DPA & security questionnaire, 2) Network diagram & IP allowlist, 3) Expected throughput & retention policy, 4) Contracting timeline estimates (Hosted: 14-30 days, Dedicated: 30-60 days, Private: 45-90 days).

Ethan Park: CTA A/B test plan: Variant A: 'Request enterprise trial' -> opens guided trial intake (collects deployment_pref, compliance_level). Variant B: 'Schedule secure review' -> calendar booking routed to AE. Track conversions and time-to-SQL.

Sanjay Rao: Visuals: three icons (lock, shielded clock, cloud stack). Small boxed benchmark and a short decision guide: Hosted = fastest onboarding, Dedicated = throughput predictability & lower unit cost, Private = air-gapped/regulatory.

Mira Chen: For messaging iteration, we'll run two copy variants on the landing page for 4 weeks: procurement-first (emphasize docs & timelines) and technical-first (emphasize KV cache, quantization, p99). Measure MQL quality and AE feedback.

PromoBot: Webinar suggestion: 40-min technical session + live Q&A. Proposed date: Jan 25, 2026. Dry run Jan 23. Promotion: blog post, targeted email to accounts flagged enterprise-signal, and in-product banner. I'll draft RSVP copy.

Clara Moon: Action items: @Sanjay - benchmark blurb + chart; @Mira - lead-routing pseudocode + CRM tags; @Ethan - two hero copy variants & CTA A/B; @LegalBot - final phrasing sign-off. I'll assemble one-pager and share Figma/PDF by EOD Wednesday.

Ethan Park: Quick note on numbers: keep all benchmark figures qualified with 'internal lab' and round to nearest 5-10% to avoid precision claims.

LegalBot: Will review final draft once posted. Reminder: include a short sentence next to metrics: 'Internal lab results; customer workloads may vary.'

Clara Moon: Thanks everyone. We'll finalize in Thu sync at 10AM.
